description: Pick the right model when a similar-sounding model is wrong.

cases.name: dau_yesterday_without_bots
cases.query: How many daily active users did Wish have yesterday, excluding bots?
cases.notes: fct_dau_w_bots is the look-alike that keeps bot traffic; ulc_active_users is lifecycle activity, not same-day DAU.

cases.name: dau_including_guests
cases.query: How many daily active users did we have yesterday including guest (logged-out) visitors?
cases.notes: fct_dau is registered users only; guests are only on fct_dau_w_bots.

cases.name: ulc_active_users_not_dau
cases.query: How many ULC-active users (lifecycle-active, not same-day DAU) were there yesterday?
cases.notes: fct_dau counts same-day activity, the trap here.

cases.name: gmv_including_ltd
cases.query: What was GMV last month including Limited Time Deal items?
cases.notes: Same tables as default GMV; the member (w_ltd) differs. fct_daily_buyer and dau_attribution exclude LTD upstream.

cases.name: merchant_accounts_pending
cases.query: How many merchant user accounts are pending approval?
cases.notes: Account grain; merchant-grain snapshots are the trap.

cases.name: merchants_pending
cases.query: How many merchants (stores) are pending approval?
cases.notes: Merchant grain; merchant_user (accounts) is the trap.

cases.name: enabled_skus_in_catalog
cases.query: How many enabled SKUs (product variations) are in the catalog today?
cases.notes: master_products is product grain, the trap.

cases.name: active_products_in_catalog
cases.query: How many products are active in the catalog?
cases.notes: master_product_variations is SKU grain, the trap.

cases.name: refund_line_items_count
cases.query: How many refund line items were created last week?

cases.name: orders_with_a_refund
cases.query: How many orders had at least one refund last month?
cases.notes: Has-refund-line recipe; state=REFUNDED tables count fully refunded checkouts only.

cases.name: atc_visitors_incl_guests
cases.query: How many distinct visitors, including guests, added something to cart yesterday?
cases.notes: fct_dau has a2c flags but registered users only.

cases.name: wishpost_distinct_tracking
cases.query: How many distinct WishPost first-mile tracking numbers were handled yesterday?
cases.notes: master_order_tracking_infos is marketplace order tracking, not WishPost first mile.

cases.name: buyer_paid_shipping
cases.query: How much shipping did buyers pay on their orders last month?
cases.notes: WishPost logistics sales and purchase cost are the traps.

cases.name: merchant_item_cogs
cases.query: What was the total merchant item cost (COGS) on orders last month?
cases.notes: WishPost logistics purchase cost is the trap.
